eps.t: Ai Comes to the Yozakura Family / Mini Kyoichiro
eps.ov: Former Tanpopo executive Ai joins the Yozakura household to reform, but peace is soon threatened.
Taiyo faces school chaos as Bronze Rank spy Sosuke Michibata targets him with sabotage and rumors.

eps.t: The Big Bro Shinzo Safety Watch Team
eps.ov: Shinzo’s shopping trip with Ayaka turns chaotic as Kengo and Nanao secretly assist him.
Taiyo faces Shinzo in a brutal game of tag during the first stage of the Spy Exam.
Taiyo faces Kyoichiro in a terrifying final exam stage where examinees vanish into the darkness.
Taiyo meets a mutated Kawashita to learn how to kill Tsubomi, but his father-in-law, Momo, appears.
Mutsumi tests Taiyo’s surging powers while Futaba fails to learn tech skills from Shion.

eps.t: Ai's Errand / Mutsumi's Major Diet Mission
eps.ov: Ai goes on her first solo errand to cheer up the family, while a disguised Taiyo and Mutsumi follow.
The Yozakuras' search for an ancient journal turns into a chaotic and revealing mansion cleanup.
Kyoichiro vanishes, but Taiyo’s date is cut short by a mysterious presence and an urgent summons.

eps.t: Operation Search for the Eldest Son
eps.ov: Taiyo finds Kyoichiro, who rejects the family and flees, causing a rift among the siblings.
Poisoned by Tsubomi, Kyoichiro flees to save his family. Taiyo desperately chases him to save him.
